source: Petersen et al. (2010) Table 2 plus explicit implementation assumptions

flight_delay_per_minute.notes: Executable SRM test weight applied to departure_delay_minutes; the paper embeds retiming in strings but Table 2 sets equipment-string assignment cost to zero.

flight_cancellation.notes: Paper magnitude retained as an abstract test-cost value, not asserted as current airline currency.

aircraft_reassignment.notes: Maps the paper benchmark's zero individual-tail assignment cost into the fixed-column test contract.

crew_reassignment.source_reference: Petersen et al. (2010), Table 2, c_(k,p)^assign = 0; implementation mapping: assumptions.md A-045
crew_reassignment.notes: Maps the paper benchmark's zero crew-pairing assignment cost into the fixed-column test contract.

passenger_delay_per_pax_minute.notes: Applied per passenger-minute in the project contract.

unserved_passenger.notes: Paper magnitude retained as an abstract test-cost value.

origin_change.notes: Transparent test-only fixed penalty; no matching coefficient is supplied by the paper.

destination_change.notes: Transparent test-only fixed penalty; no matching coefficient is supplied by the paper.

ferry_per_minute.notes: Transparent test-only rate; the paper benchmark does not publish a ferry-minute coefficient.

deadhead_per_minute.notes: The paper publishes 1,000 per deadhead flight and 2,000 for return-to-base, not a per-minute rate; this value is test-only and must not be attributed to Table 2.

notes: This profile is for deterministic Phase 2 tests and is not a calibrated airline business-cost profile.
Coefficients are frozen before solving; they were not tuned to reproduce the Phase 1 manual reference.
Each term has exactly one canonical model owner to prevent double charging in later integration.
